title: TwoLeadECG decision-margin robustness intervention
research_question: Can a training-only decision-margin penalty reduce TwoLeadECG reference/Q.ANT disagreements without materially reducing Q.ANT TEST accuracy?
hypothesis: A preregistered margin-regularized training objective will reduce mean reference/Q.ANT disagreements relative to the ordinary cross-entropy control while keeping mean Q.ANT TEST accuracy within 1 percentage point of control.
scientific_boundary: Architecture and inference are frozen. This experiment changes only the training loss. TEST data are used only for the final comparison and do not select the penalty strength.
success_criteria: Supported if margin_regularized has strictly fewer mean reference/Q.ANT disagreements than control and mean Q.ANT TEST accuracy is >= control minus 0.01.
promotion_rule: No architecture promotion. A supported result identifies margin-aware training as a compatibility intervention to validate on additional datasets.
hardware_boundary: Q.ANT CPU/software simulation only; no physical photonic hardware performance claim.
